summary: Prevent post-merge CI governance failures on integrated ticket history

delivery.outcome: Push CI validates the integrated tree from the current commit while pull-request CI remains bound to the PR base; the post-merge GOV-TICKET-001 regression is covered without weakening required checks.
nonGoals: No change to the managed governance gate or ticket activity policy.
No bypass of PR ticket binding, protected checks or trusted review.
No changes to the already merged ticket-113 implementation.

architecture.decision: Select the governance base from the event type: retain the pull-request base SHA for candidate validation and use the current push SHA for post-merge integrated-tree validation.
architecture.rollback: Revert the workflow and regression-test changes through the protected publication process.

validation.evidence: Static workflow regression asserts separate pull-request and push base expressions.
Integrated-tree validation and repository stack checks pass.
